content: João Batista Xakaihakala Tahi
Iraiti Waiyexe Enore Ityani Jesus Cristo tahi akiti hetati xowakiya
Enore niraine xakaisasehare Isaías xairahenere akereta:

content.text: Enore nexa: “Nirainikakoare naxikatya haheta maniya memere moka maheta haheta maniya. Hoka kawijita maharexakahare nali:
Memere ahoti xamohena Xekohaseti naheta, maika totaho xamohena enaheta maniya,” nita.

content: Hatyo hiyeta João Batista kaotyaka maharexakiti hoka batixaita halitinai, xakaita Iraiti Waiyexe ihiyeha. — Xahalakihena iniyalahare xománe hoka xikabatixatyaka hoka Enore maotyaneheta iniyalahare xománe — nita João ihiyeha.

Tyotya Judéia koa tyaoniterenai, exahe wenakalati Jerusalém yerenai hoka xaneha João nali hoka iniyalahare háomaneha tahi xakaita ihiye, maisa teraharetyoita, hoka tyotya batixatyahene one Jordão xa nali.
João nima atyo camelo niyali nomakere hoka ijiterone atyo militihi. Iri nijita exahe maha hoka hiyokita.
— Najikinitaite hatya noxahehare tyohena — nita halitinai hiye. — Hoka maisaiya aliyakere natyonae nameholokoa hoka ikijitini xolahi hekoti namaxolaita. Hiyaiya, natyo atyo ekatyahakohare — nexa.
— Natyo atyo nabatixaita xiso one kakoa hoka hatyo atyoite batixahena xiso Isekohaliti Waiyexe kakoa — nita.
Jesus Batixatyaka Tahi
Hatyo xowaka Jesus tyoa wenakalati Nazaré nalita, Galiléia koa nalita hoka João batixatene one Jordão xa nali.
Hikoaheta onexata taita hoka waiyehena atyo Jesus, enokoa totakore tyaona hoka hatyoakota Isekohaliti Waiyexe exoahena enomana watyaha akerehare.
Enokoata iraiti kasemaka: — Hiso atyo nityani noxiyakawali, hawaiyeta nomani, kalore haihalahalinikijita natyo — nexa.
Jesus Hasakaharetyaka Tahi
Hatyo najikinita Isekohaliti Waiyexe axikatya Jesus maharexakahare nali.
Hatyo nali 40-ki ferakene tyaona. Hatyo nali Ahalakoahaliti hasakaharetene. Hatyo nali tehitiya kirakahare xalijiniharexenai tyaonita xakore hoka anjonai atyo kaxaikotene.
Jesus Hahena Galiléia Nali Hotohare
Hatyaoseta João kaberexotyakehenere najikinita Jesus xane Galiléia koa Iraiti Waiyexe Xekohaseti Enore nalitare tyohenere tahi akiti xakai maheta.
— Aimenekohenere aosetya xane hikoahena. Okoitya xekohaseti Enore nalitare kaokehena, xahalakihenaira xománe iniyalahare hoka Iraiti Waiyexe xityakekohena — nita ihiyeha.
Haxowakiya Jesus tonakilihijita one Galiléia hoka waiya hinamahare haximarene kakoarenae Simão Pedro, André xoaha. Maka kakoa mairatyahitaha, mairatyatiyenai hoka.
— Xisohena noximi hoka naotyakisa xiso hoka haliti nolokasehare xisaona — nexa Jesus ihiyeha.
Hatyaoseta halakisaha rotita kohase hiyakakala hoka xaneha Jesus xema.
Jiyehitiya maisekoneta hoka waiya hinamahare haximarene kakoarenai Tiago, João xoaha, Zebedeu ityaninai. Kanowako tinolaharehenahititaha maka kohase hiyakakala.
Kawisahene hoka halakisaha rotita hanexeha Zebedeu, ewakaneharenai harenai kanowakota hoka xaneha Jesus xema.
Hatya Haliti Kakoa Isekohaliti Iniyalahare Tyaonita
Hatyaoseta Jesus haxaotyakiraharenae kakoa xane kaoka wenakalati Cafarnaum nali. Sábado ferakene xane xahohisakoatyakalati hanako aotyakisa halitinai maheta.
Exaotyakira semaha hoka hakaharetyoaha, iraeta atyo iyateliti kakoare hoka. Maisa judeunai xaotyakiraho kakoa waiyoreterenai akereta xini aotyakijita hoka hatyo hiyeta hakaharetyoaha.
Aotyakijita ene hoka tihanare kamilakorerahare tyaonita enekonyaha hoka kinatyaxa irai Jesus kakoa:
— Xoare haoka wihiye, Jesus Nazaré yere? Xoana hisoa hamawenekoaretya maheta wiso? Waiye atyo hawaiyekehalakahareta nomani. Hiso atyo Enore Xaxikalahare Waiyexe — nexa.
Hoka Jesus nexa tihanare hiye: — Nikareta hirae hoka hahikoahetehena hatyo haliti nonitata! nexa.
Hatyaoseta tihanare atatakoakisene, awerahalikikoatene hoka hikoaheta enonita.

Hatyo hiyeta tyotyaha hakaharetyoaha hoka axakakoahenaha: — Xoanere kaisere? Xoanere, waitare xaotyakiye kakoala aotyakijita? Xiyaiya, iraihena tihanarenai kakoa hoka tyakekota iniraine — nexakakoaha.
Hatyo hiyeta tyotya Galiléia koa yerenae haxerore semaha Jesus tahi akiti.
Jesus Aiyatolokiheta Pedro Nakero
Hatyaoseta Jesus haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa hikoahenahitaha xahohisakoatyakalati hanakota hoka xaneha rotita Tiago, João xoaha kakoa Simão Pedro, André xoaha hana nali xeta.
Exowaka Simão nimasero hokakita hoka ehokotyoita, watyahiseta hoka. Hatyaoseta Jesus kaoka taita hoka xakai etahi akiti ihiye.
Hatyaoseta xane ehokotyoitere nali hoka otokene ekahe hiye hoka aokanikisene. Aokanikihetene hoka ewatyahisene tyoteheta enonita hoka xane nakairati tyoma enomanaha.
Jesus Aiyatelekiheta Hokakiterenai
Okoi kamai isoahena hoka kolatyaha tyotya hokakiterenae, exahe tihanare kamilakoreraharenae Jesus ana.
Tyotya hatyo wenakalati tyaoniterenai xane hohisakoaha hati kanase nali.

Jesus kahare haliti aiyatelikiheta tyotya kawakiti hawarehare kahehare kakoarenae, exahe kahare axanekiheta tihanarenae enonyahitaha. Hatyo tihanarenae ana atyo waiyekehalakahareta Jesus hoka hatyo hiyeta Jesus mairaenityahitene.
Jesus Galiléia Nali
Kamaetali makahekoasetata hoka Jesus kaose hoka xane maharexakahare hoka nali iraexatya.
Xane hoka hatyaoseta Simão Pedro, hahinaeharenae kakoa tawaha hakakoare Jesus xahita.
Xane kaokehenahitene hoka: — Tyotyahaore tawahitaha hiso — nexaha ihiye.
Hoka Jesus nexa ihiyeha: — Wiyala hakiti wenakalati wihaliyeterenai nali hoka noxakai Iraiti Waiyexe ihiyeha. Hatyo niyahare notyoa — nexa.
Hatyaoseta Jesus xane tyotya wenakalatinae Galiléia koa nali hoka Iraiti Waiyexe xakaita ihiyeha xahohisakoatyakalati hanakonai, exahe tihanarenai hoka axanekihitita.
Jesus Awaiyehiheta Jijikoahitere
Hatyaoseta jijikoahiti kahehare aijitere kaoka Jesus ana, hakaoliri kakoa meholokoa enomana axene maheta. — Hawaiyehihetaiya natyo haokowi hoka hawaiyehihetaiya natyo — nexa Jesus hiye.
Jesus airakoaneharetene hoka hakahe ekaokakisa ihiye hoka nexa ihiye: — Há, naokaite. Hawaiyehiheta atyo — nexa.
Hatyaoseta jijikoahiti kahehare tyoteheta enonita hoka kinatereheta.
Hatyaoseta Jesus kinatyaxa irai ekakoa.

— Awaira atyo hiyakaikoahena exehare hatya hiye. Hiyane sacerdote nali hoka hahotikisoa enomana. Hatyaosetaite Moisés aokitere akereta hisa enomana hoka Enore ana fetatene. Hoka tyotyaha waiyoreha hikinaterehenere kakoa — nexa Jesus ihiye.

Xakore hoka xaneheta hoka hakakoare xakaikoatene hoka tyotyaha semaha etahi. Hatyo hiyeta maisaiya Jesus aliyakere wenakalatinai koa xanehitita hoka maharexakahare nali xane tyaonita hoka hakakoare wenakalatinae tyaoniterenae tawitene.
